verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway, and a gateway could plausibly offer user-defined event-to-action automation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only fixed built-in behaviors: fallback retries on model failure, load-balancing weights, auto caching and spend caps. These are adjacent routing and governance controls, not a general facility for defining rules that trigger actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
